items.title: Diwali, the Festival of Lights
parts: Diwali is called the festival of lights.
Families clean their homes and light little lamps called diyas.
People make colourful rangoli patterns and share sweets with neighbours.
Diwali is a happy time to be together.

items.title: Eid
parts: Eid is a happy festival celebrated by Muslim families.
People wear new clothes and visit family and friends.
Many families share sweet dishes like sheer khurma.
